title: State bounds imply coordinate bounds
statement: Let $B$ be a natural number and let $\mathrm{st}$ be a state record with fifteen natural-number coordinates, whose coordinate vector lists those coordinates in order. If each coordinate of $\mathrm{st}$ is at most $B$, then every entry of its coordinate vector is at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: Each coordinate of st is at most B
